description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Enraged Huorn trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
